WorkflowDocumentFormat.description: Source encoding for a user-, project-, or plugin-owned workflow document.

WorkflowEngine.description: Execution engine selected by a `zuno.workflow/v1` document.

WorkflowScope.description: Discovery authority that supplied a workflow. This is provenance, not a precedence promise; `workflowId` remains the opaque selector.

WorkflowSourceIdentity.description: Immutable identity for one exact workflow source document.

digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact source bytes.

source.description: Human-readable source provenance, such as a path or plugin resource id.

WorkflowSummary.description: A discovered and validated workflow. Zuno does not reserve names for built-in business workflows; every entry comes from a discoverable source.

executableDigest.description: Digest of all executable material. For `scriptFile` workflows this binds both the document and resolved script bytes.

workflowId.description: Opaque registry selector. Callers must not derive this from the name.

definition.description: Parsed definition for clients that do not need source-level editing.

document.description: Exact source text. Keeping the text preserves YAML comments and makes the digest independently verifiable by clients.
